mechanism: Vedolizumab may impair immune function and potentially reduce vitamin D's immunomodulatory effects; cholecalciferol may enhance gut-associated lymphoid tissue function affecting vedolizumab's selective gut targeting.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels during vedolizumab therapy and ensure adequate cholecalciferol supplementation, as IBD patients on vedolizumab may have increased vitamin D malabsorption or deficiency risk.
